svg.text: ESP32-C3 Super Mini + GC9A01 round TFT + NEO-6M GPS + GY-511 compass + KY-040 push button. Pins as in src/hal/boards/custom/.
Everything runs from the Super Mini's 3V3 pin
Wire colours follow the breadboard build.
Display pin order varies by vendor: match labels.
GPS VCC also accepts 5 V (onboard LDO).
GPIO2, 8 and 9 are strapping pins and must be high
at reset: wire nothing that pulls them low at boot.
the boot log prints on GPIO21).
Grey, dashed pins are not connected.
